current_biggest_measured_problem: The login page advertised guest access even though the current backend configuration disabled it.
evidence: A current-source frontend browser session used a corrected local proxy and real current-source Django settings.
The user simulator clicked the guest action once and received the backend message '游客体验当前未开放。'. A registration tab was already visible; the simulator stopped without selecting it.
The deployed Docker image was approximately nine hours old and returned an unrelated login verification failure; it was excluded as current-source evidence.
root_cause: The frontend rendered a Guest entry without consulting the backend capability flag.
affected_layer: Frontend account entry and backend capability contract
proposed_change: Expose the existing backend guest and registration configuration through a read-only auth-options endpoint; render only enabled entry modes, and preserve login plus a clear registration fallback if the capability request fails.
expected_improvement: Remove an action that the current backend cannot fulfill.
Keep users on a valid login or registration path.
Avoid duplicating feature-toggle state in frontend configuration.
regression_risks: A failed capability request must not hide all recovery paths.
The UI must not infer or enable guest access independently of backend settings.
next_experiment: Compare the prior disabled-guest CTA with the backend-driven candidate using a fresh no-account task and a blind screenshot judge.
